speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) in the past three years, how many summonses have been issued to offenders who feed pigeons; and (b) what other measures can the Ministry introduce to deter the feeding of pigeons.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: NParks also works with Town Councils to put up notices to ask for information about feeding activities, so as to carry out enforcement operations in a more targeted manner.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: NParks, the National Environment Agency (NEA) and the Town Councils work together to educate residents about the environmental health and hygiene issues caused by pigeon feeding.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is done through advisories, posters and outreach events.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Agencies are also working with the Municipal Services Office (MSO) to develop targeted public education messages and materials.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The community and grassroots leaders can also help to spread the message.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: To reduce the availability of food sources for pigeons, NEA ensures good food waste management in food centres and coffee shops in Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates and enforces against littering.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Residents can and should also play their part by helping to maintain the overall cleanliness of their estates.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: I have had many complaints about pigeons at hawker centres, on window ledges, at everywhere.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: And the bird droppings, I understand, are considered to be infectious.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: So, I am asking the Senior Parliamentary Secretary: can NParks do more to step up enforcement?

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Following what the hon Member Mr Louis Ng said, can there be more manpower given to NParks to enforce more, step up more patrols, do more advisories, because when the Town Council talks to the residents, many a time, they are ignored?

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: So, there should be greater enforcement to send the signal that feeding of pigeons is not something that is legal.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Would the Senior Parliamentary Secretary also consider increasing the penalties for pigeon feeding?

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: The message has not gotten to many of these pigeon feeders that whatever they are doing is causing health risks to many other people.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Because if we know when the pigeon feeder normally comes out, it is easier for us to catch the pigeon feeder in action.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, information such as this from residents, grassroots leaders and the community will be very helpful in allowing us to be more effective in the way we conduct our enforcement.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, I think we can put more of this information out.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I would also like to share with the Member that there was this high-rise littering/pigeon feeding pilot in Yio Chu Kang that was actually spearheaded by one of my colleagues.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: On the enforcement front, not only do they deploy cameras to basically enforce and find out who the pigeon feeders are, they also put up captured images of the offenders.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, it is helpful in creating community awareness.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: They also work with the local Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) to engage vulnerable and/or recalcitrant offenders.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Because while we have our fines, and we enforce when we catch – as I mentioned, they can be fined up to $500 per offence – we also find that, sometimes, some of these offenders may have some other issues that they are dealing with.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: If we are able to work with the community, we can also reach out to the families and friends of these offenders and see how we can deter such behaviour from them.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: Similarly, in my constituency, we have a lot of pigeon issues.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: So, I listened with great interest in the pilot that the Senior Parliamentary Secretary spoke about.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: All the things that the Senior Parliamentary Secretary spoke about, we have attempted.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: And I would say, over the last eight or nine years, I do not see much result.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: We have done everything that she has suggested.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: The pilot that she just mentioned, I listened with great interest, and I would like to ask the Senior Parliamentary Secretary when this can be rolled out to the other parts of Singapore.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: It also includes community solutioning, which includes putting up educational materials which I am sure the Member has attempted.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: We would look into it further and see how we can roll it out to different locations.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: As we understand it, pigeon feeding issues are quite local-based.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: It depends on the local infrastructure, the demographics of the residents who live in a certain area, certain habits and the interaction between food centres in the local community.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, while we currently seem to have a pilot that has seemed to have worked quite well in Yio Chu Kang, we will probably have to distill it further and work closely with the local Members of Parliament and grassroots advisors to see how we can adapt it for use in the local community.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I just want to go back to the point of whether MND can increase the manpower for the surveillance team because I think that is the crunch at this point, the bottleneck where we do not have enough officers to do the surveillance to tackle the feeding.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: My second point is: a lot of us have focused on culling, and culling is actually not the solution.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: That is the problem: the more you cull, the more pigeons you have.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think we take the Member's points and we will see how we can work more effectively and efficiently on that.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I believe that the Town Councils' first option is probably not to cull.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think they have worked very actively with NEA and NParks to enforce, like I mentioned, on pigeon feeders.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Any strategy towards managing such local issues would include a variety of different initiatives.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And culling is just but one part of it.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: People normally would much rather not do if they do not have to.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: NParks is also looking at a variety of other initiatives.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Indeed, where effective, we will try to roll it out to different communities and see how we can develop a holistic solution towards this issue that we face.
